reason: The headline claim is confounded, and the action adds a risk. (1) Scale bias. The GT mid is measured on raw integer-voxel annotations; forkmid and the 5.9% dose use FINAL linefit-smoothed coordinates. On the 56 exp60 clips, plain 1-step displacements >= 4.5 um are 2.4% on final coords, 9.3% on presafe coords and 8.1% in GT (95th pct 3.83 vs 5.45 vs 5.30 um). Smoothing shrinks the 4.5 um tail ~3-4x, so '17% of GT divisions' is not the TP flag rate of a rule that runs on final coords. (2) Conditional geometry. GT mid>=4.5 divisions are wide pairs (sister median 11.75 um, cos median -0.03). Predicted mid>=4.5 forks are same-side close pairs (sister 6.21, cos 0.58). Restricted to cos>0.25, it is GT 5/151 (3.3%) vs pred 34/676 (5.0%): weakly enriched (~1.5x). That is neither 'not enriched' nor proof of extra TP risk. (3) 'Read a removed-TP=0 pass with the base rate in mind' invites a discretionary override of a frozen gate, against R1-R10 discipline. (4) The contingency 'forkmid fails -> K3 = K2 + ANTIPAR' can re-admit forkmid's vetoes under a looser gate. ANTIPAR holds 34/40 forkmid forks on all 56 clips (not only 14/16) and tolerates TP<=1, while L3 requires 0 TP. That is a closed line in disguise. Facts that hold: dt=1 for all 151 GT divisions; sister<=5 enrichment; the forkblob closure. No T9 forkmid result is on disk yet, so a coupling clause can still be pre-registered honestly.
fix: Record R2S-6 as INFO only, with the corrected numbers (scale-biased marginal; cos>0.25-conditional enrichment ~1.5x; overlap 34/40). Judge forkmid strictly by its frozen gate, with no 'base-rate weighting' of a pass. Pre-register now, before the T9 forkmid rows are read, a coupling clause for ANTIPAR: if forkmid fails because of a removed evaluable TP fork, and that fork is also in ANTIPAR's veto set, ANTIPAR fails too. Otherwise ANTIPAR is gated on its full set AND on ANTIPAR minus forkmid (0 TP there). If forkmid passes, ANTIPAR is judged on its increment only. For any future GT-vs-pred displacement comparison, measure the prediction on presafe (unsmoothed) coords, or GT through the same linefit.
realistic_gain: About 0 LB directly (no rule change). The coupling clause avoids a plausible -0.001 to -0.003 private loss: 1-3 real divisions dropped at ~-0.003 each on ~22-ish public GT divisions, if ANTIPAR re-admitted the TP forks that failed forkmid. It costs no runtime, and the clause is only text in CONTEXT.
